name: After recital N
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text: Na. whereas the innovative regulatory framework referring to substance-based medical devices, which was introduced by the MDR, is intended to encourage the development of therapies that act through non-pharmacological, non-immunological and non-metabolic means; whereas guidelines and decisions issued by national authorities set limits that classify products falling within the scope of the MDR under other regulatory categories, which goes against the EU legislator’s aim of fostering therapeutic innovation;
